description: This file implements an embedder class for the Ollama API, providing methods for creating embeddings and validating configuration, including error handling and telemetry integration.

classes.name: CodeIndexOllamaEmbedder
classes.description: A class implementing the IEmbedder interface using a local Ollama instance, capable of creating embeddings and validating the Ollama service configuration.

methods.name: createEmbeddings
methods.description: Creates text embeddings using the specified or default Ollama model, with error handling and telemetry.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the Ollama embedder configuration by checking service availability, model existence, and embedding capability.

methods.name: embedderInfo
methods.description: Getter providing information about the embedder, specifically its name.
